einzeiler: The future of the young conservative movement and Trump's midterms pitch.
kurzfassung: This episode examines the state of the young conservative movement following the death of activist Charlie Kirk. It looks at who might take on his influence and whether young voters will maintain their support. Additionally, the discussion covers President Trump's campaign proposal of a 5,000 dollar check.
stichpunkte: Support for conservative causes among young voters after Charlie Kirk
Potential successors to carry on Kirk's influence
Future retention of young conservative voters
President Trump's pitch of a 5,000 dollar check tied to midterm control
beschreibung:
The activist is credited for increasing support of conservative causes among young voters, but nobody has had a similar influence since Kirk was killed last year. Who may pick up the mantle, and will these voters continue to support conservatives?

Plus, a discussion of President Trump's latest pitch to voters: a $5,000 check if Republicans maintain control of Congress after the midterms.

This episode: voting correspondent Miles Parks, political reporter Elena Moore, and senior national political correspondent Mara Liasson.

This podcast was produced and edited by Casey Morell and Bria Suggs.

Our executive producer is Muthoni Muturi.
